text:
mike: FYI customer hit failures on /rerank after they started using a different embed model yesterday. They see 400s and also 'weird ordering' in some test cases. attaching logs.

sara: can you paste the request body and the error? makes it easier to triage than screenshots :eyes:

mike: here's the payload they sent (redacted keys):

```json
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "query_embedding": [0.12, -0.03, ... , 0.07],
  "candidates": [
    {"id": "a1", "embedding": [0.11, -0.02, ... , 0.06], "text": "..."},
    {"id": "a2", "embedding": [0.09, -0.01, ... , 0.04], "text": "..."}
  ],
  "embedding_model": "embed-small-v1",
  "rerank_model": "rerank-xl-v2"
}
```

mike: error response was:

```json
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{
  "error": "embedding dimension mismatch: query 512 != candidate 768"
}
```

alex: ah that's the classic mixed-dim problem. They switched the client embed model to embed-small-v1 (512d) but the candidate set still has precomputed 768d vectors from embed-large-v2. The reranker validates dims and rejects when they differ.

ben: does the rerank endpoint accept a 'model' param to re-embed candidates server-side? customer expects server to accept arbitrary dims and handle internally.

sara: currently rerank expects all vectors to match a single expected dimensionality per request. We do have an option to pass raw texts instead of embeddings so the service will compute embeddings with the rerank-compatible model before scoring. But that has latency/cost tradeoffs.

eng-ops-bot: TRACE 1865000001 -> route=rerank /validate dims: q=512 candidates=768 reject

mike: repro steps I used locally:
1) generate embeddings with embed-small-v1 for query
2) upload candidate set previously computed with embed-large-v2 (768d)
3) call /v1/rerank with embedding vectors included

results: immediate 400. If I instead pass candidate texts (no embeddings) it succeeds and uses rerank-xl-v2's encoder (768d) for everything.

alex: quick mitigation options for customer:
- re-run candidate embedding job with embed-small-v1 to match query dims (best accuracy/consistency)
- switch client to request raw texts to rerank API (server will compute with rerank_model)
- use an adapter service to up/down-project vectors (not recommended, noisy)

ben: any chance to improve UX: return a clearer error that suggests the right model pair? e.g., "expected 768d. Use embed-large-v2 or pass texts" instead of generic mismatch.

sara: agreed. logging note: add which model produced expected dims in error message. I'll open a small change request.

infra-bot: created ticket INF-4892 "rerank dimension mismatch: friendlier error + hint" assigned to sara

mike: customer accepts workaround to switch to raw texts for a few days while they backfill the candidate embeddings. They also asked whether we can provide a small script to check candidate vector dims before upload.

alex: I'll paste a tiny validation script they can run (python):

```python
# validate_dims.py
import json
vecs = json.load(open('candidates.json'))
lengths = set(len(v['embedding']) for v in vecs)
if len(lengths) != 1:
    print('inconsistent candidate dims:', lengths)
else:
    print('candidate dims ok:', lengths.pop())
```

ben: note for docs: add a short section in rerank guide about embed+rerank model families and dimensionality expectations.

sara: created PR draft for both the error text and a new docs blurb. assigning to docs reviewer.

mike: marking this thread resolved for support. Customer will backfill and reopen if issues persist. :thumbsup:

eng-ops-bot: incident link https://redwood.ops/incidents/INF-4892
